I kept the preset but swapped its lane-network for open-battlefield, because a forest with enemies appearing 20 studs away in any direction is dispersed contested ground rather than channelled lanes, and dropped its building-interior since nothing in a bare forest is entered, which also keeps the build off P3. Ammo spawning on the ground is collectible-loot, bent to ammunition rather than weapons. Decided without a user: endless survival per the goal answer, so no finish or exit geometry, and a bright stylized forest as the dressing.
